opening.argument: The presentation promotes OneCoin participation by explaining how viewers can get started and urging them to get involved. It describes Tycoon participation as requiring a significant financial commitment, including spending about six thousand dollars, while promising that entry can pay back 100 times its cost if participants do what is required to obtain its benefits. The opportunity is tied to recruitment: “The more people you expose to one coin in our system the more success you can achieve,” alongside discussion of building massive teams. It further claims that those who join today will be far ahead of those who wait 30 days, while free enrollments are directed toward a paid package. These recruitment commissions, tiered participation levels, conditional returns, and urgency establish the offered scheme’s deceptive character.
